style: Broadcast LED-wall typography: deep navy screen (#070B1F -> #121A3D) with a drifting orange radial glow and a very faint pixel-grid/scanline texture; heavy Montserrat 900/800 (600 for small labels), left-anchored column under a small logo bug; snappy per-word mask-rise synced to the presenter's voice

customize.yt-screen-warp: reuse the .yt-screen-fx overlay recipe (sheen + scanlines + pixel grid + inset vignette) as the always-on LED texture, alpha lowered to 'very faint'; no 3D warp (the master composites onto the wall)
customize.directional-wipe: reuse the clip-path inset reveal + light-sweep fx + outgoing push/blur for the scene 1 -> 2 transition, recolored to a brand-orange wipe bar, retimed to 0.18 s
customize.headline-slam: reuse the deterministic three-frame landing shake on the 'GÜNÜ!' punch and the 'TAMAMLANDI' stamp impact
customize.success-check: reuse the SVG ring + tick path draw (stroke-dashoffset) inside the stamp pill, tinted white/orange

queries: CRT screen power on horizontal line turn on
old tv turn on effect light line expands
LED pixel grid scanlines screen texture
mask reveal headline words rise kinetic slam
fast wipe push transition between scenes
progress bar fill race track finish flag
stamp slam badge completed check mark
hand_authored_gaps: screen power-on light line (no catalog item)
race track with finish flag (mk-progress-stat is a stat card, not a race track)
per-word mask rise keyed to explicit voice onsets inside one multi-scene root (per-word-rise is a single-line block)

scenes.motion: thin white/orange light line scaleX 0->1 at vertical centre (0.00-0.12, expo.out), screen clip-path opens from the centre line to full frame (0.08-0.36), white flash decays; logo bug fades/slides in 0.40-0.80

scenes.text: BÜYÜK EMEĞİN / VE MÜCADELENİN / SON GÜNÜ!
scenes.motion: per-word mask-rise (yPercent 135->0 + autoAlpha, 0.30 s, power4.out) starting 0.04 s before each onset; 'SON GÜNÜ!' 156 px orange: line scale punch 1->1.07->1 on GÜNÜ! landing + three-frame stage shake + glow pulse
orange wipe bar sweeps right->left (power3.inOut 0.18 s); scene 2 revealed behind it via clip-path, scene 1 clipped ahead of it while pushed left -120 px

scenes.text: 2026 / GÜMRÜK SINAVLARI / HAZIRLIK MARATONU + track + TAMAMLANDI
scenes.motion: '2026' 160 px orange digits rise with 0.035 s stagger (expo.out); GÜMRÜK/SINAVLARI/HAZIRLIK/MARATONU 94 px white 800 rise on onsets; track groove draws in 4.2-4.5; orange fill scaleX 0->1 + glowing runner knob 4.5-6.0 (sine.inOut) with %0->%100 counter; finish flag pops at 6.0; stamp slams 5.90->6.04 (scale 2.2->1, rotation -16->-6, power3.in) + shake + shock ring + tick draw
bright horizontal scan band sweeps top->bottom (0.20 s); scene 3 revealed above it, scene 2 clipped below it

scenes.text: AYLAR SÜREN YORUCU BİR DÖNEM / BİRLİK VE / BERABERLİK İÇİNDE / GERİDE BIRAKIYORUZ
scenes.motion: small line 46 px 600 white@70% words rise (power2.out) on AYLAR 6.76 / SÜREN 7.12 / YORUCU 7.60 / BİR DÖNEM 7.92; hero 128 px white 900 BİRLİK 8.64 / VE 8.96 / BERABERLİK 9.12 rise (circ.out from slight scale), İÇİNDE 68 px at 9.68; orange underline sweeps under BERABERLİK 9.30-9.75; GERİDE 10.08 / BIRAKIYORUZ 10.373 orange 96 px; glow pulse then still hold 10.65-11.13 (no fade-out)

layout.content_column: left-anchored at x=60, vertically centred in y 170-690 (below the logo bug)

brief: Kinetic-type title on a studio LED wall. The screen powers on with a horizontal light line, then three spoken lines build word-by-word exactly on the voice onsets: a heavy white three-line headline punching into orange 'SON GÜNÜ!', an orange '2026' over the exam-marathon lines with a race track filling to 100% and a 'TAMAMLANDI' stamp slamming onto the finish, and a closing hero 'BİRLİK VE BERABERLİK' with an orange underline sweep resolving into orange 'GERİDE BIRAKIYORUZ'. Dominant motif: words rising out of masks on the beat; one pattern interrupt per scene (scale punch, stamp slam, underline sweep); transitions vary (orange wipe, scan refresh).
